title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #119 · 명화 믹스 · 대각 띠·매끈 · 5영역(클림트+호쿠사이+반 고흐+칸딘스키+리히텐슈타인) · 풀커버 · powerlifter bombshell · 3/4 각도·팔 위로 · Japanese · 배경 호텔 로비 · 아게하
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, mid 30s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, waist-length braids chocolate brown hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 diagonal bands by 4 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 33% of the way down her figure from the top, about 47% of the way down her figure from the top, about 59% of the way down her figure from the top and about 80% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries Klimt style golden spirals and mosaic squares with ornate gold, black and green geometric ornaments. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Hokusai Great Wave style, rolling indigo waves with white foam claws and bold black linework. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Van Gogh Starry Night style swirling thick brushstrokes in deep ultramarine, cobalt and glowing yellow, big spiralling skies flowing over her curves. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries Kandinsky style abstract composition of bold circles, triangles and sweeping lines in saturated red, blue, yellow and black. Region 5 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries Lichtenstein style pop-art Ben-Day dots and thick black outlines in primary red, yellow and blue. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, her legs fully in view — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy black lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a bright luxury hotel lobby with a polished pale marble floor, a standard-height entrance door, a curved staircase and a long reception counter, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
